baseline_models.focus_anchor: The voiced appeal رَبِّ governs لَا تَذَرْ ... مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sovereign address, the operator of leaving, terrestrial scope, truth-covering affiliation, and the place-attached resident converge on a request for zero remaining members of that resident class.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech makes the request an explicit act rather than an unvoiced wish.
Lordship and authority identify the addressee as the one who decides what remains.
Leaving or letting be supplies the retention operator that the negation cancels.
The lower ground opposite the sky gives the request its complete terrestrial field.
Covering or rejecting truth defines the class whose continued residence is denied.
Attachment to a residence supplies the concrete image of even one remaining inhabitant.

changed_reading.before: A bare wish that nobody be left.
changed_reading.after: A formally voiced appeal to sovereign authority that not one earth-attached resident of the truth-covering class remain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الْأَرْضِ, الْكَافِرِينَ, and دَيَّارًا bind ground, covering, and residence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fertile ground, seed-covering, and attachment to a dwelling form a material analogy in which concealment is not only an opinion but something lodged in an inhabited substrate.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies the substrate in which a covered thing can remain lodged.
Covering seed gives concealment a latent, materially embedded image.
The resident attached to a place turns that embedded concealment into a habitation pattern.

changed_reading.before: The verse removes people carrying a doctrinal label.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks that settled concealment no longer remain implanted in the inhabited earth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated leaving of any دَيَّار is read through the circular range of د و ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinary resident sense remains primary, while the branch image of circulation adds a systems-level possibility: leaving even one resident would leave one carrier through which the same state could turn again.

activation_trace.role: Leaving something in place supplies the survival condition for a continuing circuit.
Truth-covering supplies the state that could be carried forward.
Turning and encircling supply the image of recurrence beyond the literal resident.

changed_reading.after: No surviving carrier should remain through whom the truth-covering circuit can turn again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling reaches the group repeatedly and through public and private registers, but they install their own cover against reception. The focus class therefore reads less like an inherited label and more like a maintained access-blocking shell whose residents carry it forward.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies the attempted communicative access.
A cover laid over the self supplies the mechanism that blocks that access.
Raised public speech shows that overt delivery was tried.
Hidden or inward address shows that private delivery was also tried.
Covering truth names the stabilized result of repeated access refusal.
The resident image makes each remaining person a durable carrier of that shell.

structural_cues: 71:5-9 varies night and day, repeated calling, overt declaration, and secrecy.
71:7 places bodily hearing barriers and clothing between the call and its recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive delivery modes and self-covering refusal; I infer that persistence through every access mode converts an episode of disbelief into a self-maintaining shell. A live alternative is that the sequence only documents intensity of refusal without defining the focus class mechanistically.

changed_reading.before: Remove all residents identified as disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: After every channel of address has been met by an actively maintained shell, leave no resident carrier through whom that shell can persist.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier delay is bounded by a fixed term that cannot be deferred once it arrives, and drowning is narrated immediately before the petition. The focus request can therefore function as closure at an already reached endpoint: no remnant is to be carried beyond the completed adverse turn.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the temporary interval before closure.
The fixed temporal limit supplies the endpoint beyond which delay cannot extend.
Arrival supplies the transition from available delay to realized endpoint.
Drowning as lethal action marks the adverse endpoint as already realized in the narrative sequence.
The leave operator now concerns whether any remainder crosses the endpoint.
The adverse turn or defeat gives the resident's removal a terminal rather than initiating role.

structural_cues: 71:4 says the appointed term is not delayed once it comes.
71:25 uses completed passive actions before 71:26 reports Noah's speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded delay, arrival, and completed drowning before the focus speech; I infer that the prayer ratifies total closure rather than initiating an unbounded catastrophe. A live alternative is that narrative order is rhetorical and does not fix the speech's chronology.

changed_reading.before: No disbelieving inhabitant should be left from this moment onward.
changed_reading.after: At the non-deferrable endpoint already displayed, let no resident remnant be carried past the completed judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The leaders' voiced command uses the same leave/retain operator to preserve named cult objects; Noah's voiced command turns that operator back on the command's human carriers. The prayer becomes a formal counter-imperative that ends the preservation system by removing its resident maintainers.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech frames the earlier preservation slogan as an explicit command.
Repeated leaving or abandoning supplies the exact retention operator later reversed in the focus.
The named worshipped idol supplies one concrete object the earlier command protects.
A second named idol confirms that the command organizes continued cultic retention.
Noah's uttered speech supplies the answering command frame.
The same leave operator is redirected from protected objects to their resident protectors.
The place-attached resident identifies the human infrastructure whose retention would preserve the cult.

structural_cues: 71:23 repeats لَا تَذَرُنَّ around a list of named objects; 71:26 answers with لَا تَذَرْ.
Both commands are introduced by forms of قَالَ, making the reversal formally audible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched speech frames, the repeated leave verb, and the shift from cult objects to disbelieving residents; I infer a deliberate counter-preservation structure. A live alternative is simple lexical repetition without a formal reversal mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Reverse their command to preserve the cult: leave none of the resident human maintainers who could keep that preservation order in force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans are figured as growth from earth, return into it, and renewed extraction; the later conditional adds offspring generated from the existing population and labels the output with concealment. The focus combination of fertile earth, covered seed, and circulation can therefore ask for interruption of a terrestrial-social regeneration circuit, not only removal of current adults.

activation_trace.role: Human growth and nurture supply the first stage of a terrestrial generation model.
Return after departure supplies the circuit's inward movement back into earth.
Passage to the outside supplies the circuit's renewed outward movement.
Something produced from something else connects biological succession to continued social output.
Seed-covering gives the predicted offspring a latent recurrence image.
Fertile earth anchors the circuit in the focus verse's own spatial substrate.
Leaving even one carrier supplies the condition under which succession could continue.
Circular movement supplies the systems image that joins return, emergence, and succession.

structural_cues: 71:17-18 gives a compact growth, return, and extraction sequence centered on earth.
71:27 makes leaving the present group causally antecedent to both misleading and future birth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earth-return-extraction sequence and a separate birth-to-concealment prediction; I infer that one remaining resident can couple the biological and social cycles. A live alternative keeps resurrection imagery and ordinary genealogy as separate mechanisms.

changed_reading.before: Remove every currently living disbelieving inhabitant.
changed_reading.after: Break the earth-linked succession circuit at its remaining resident nodes so that concealment is not generated again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is spread as traversable surface and articulated by entered routes, extended ways, and wide passes. Against that network, عَلَى الْأَرْضِ and دَيَّارًا become a spatial saturation claim: no settled or circulating node anywhere in the habitable route system is exempt.

activation_trace.role: Spread earth as a carpet supplies a continuous habitable surface.
Penetrating a route supplies movement through that surface.
The extended traveled road supplies the network's connective edges.
Wide open mountain passes expand the network beyond a single settlement.
The focus earth receives the network-wide scope built by the context.
The place-attached resident supplies the settlement node distributed over that network.

structural_cues: 71:19-20 moves from the whole spread earth to the purpose of traversing its broad ways.
The focus repeats earth and adds the exhaustive singular دَيَّارًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spread surface, traversal, routes, and passes; I infer a settlement-and-mobility network over which the focus negation ranges. A live alternative is that these verses only amplify geographic scope without changing the resident reading.

changed_reading.before: Not one inhabitant should remain in an unspecified place.
changed_reading.after: Across the whole traversable settlement network of the spread earth, no resident node or mobile remainder is outside the request's scope.

context_deltas.mechanism: The predicted offspring line is followed by a prayer for protective forgiveness covering Noah, parents, believing entrants, and believing men and women. The focus is thereby bounded by a selective habitation rule: the disbelieving resident line is denied continuation while a faith-defined household of entry and kinship is positively retained.

activation_trace.role: Offspring from a lineage supplies the negative continuity that the focus request interrupts.
Protective covering of fault supplies the positive preservation requested for the contrasting group.
Entry into an interior supplies a membership threshold rather than an ethnic boundary.
Household and family supply the positive social container opposed to the excluded resident class.
Security and trusting calm supply the criterion shared by entrant and wider believing community.
Truth-covering marks the specifically excluded affiliation rather than humanity as such.
The place-attached resident becomes one side of a contrasted habitation membership rule.

structural_cues: 71:26 restricts the negated residents with مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ.
71:28 immediately names parents, a believing house entrant, believing men, and believing women as recipients of forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an excluded resident class followed by protected kin, entrant, and faith classes; I infer that the prayer redraws household membership rather than seeking undifferentiated human absence. A live alternative treats the house reference as a separate personal prayer with no spatial answer to دَيَّارًا.

changed_reading.before: The verse sounds like an undifferentiated request for depopulation.
changed_reading.after: The verse denies continuity to one truth-covering resident line while the next prayer positively preserves a permeable, faith-defined household and community.

context_deltas.mechanism: One ayah juxtaposes an offered protective covering of fault with the hearers' chosen covering of themselves; later they are comprehensively covered by water. The focus root ك ف ر then sits inside a sequence of rival covering regimes: sheltering forgiveness refused, obstructive covering adopted, engulfing covering incurred.

activation_trace.role: Covering fault while protecting its bearer supplies the offered beneficial covering.
A self-applied upper cover supplies the obstructive covering chosen instead.
Comprehensive engulfment supplies the terminal physical covering.
Covering and concealment anchor the three-stage reversal in the focus class name.
The ground opposite the sky marks the surface from which the engulfed coverers are not to reappear as residents.

structural_cues: 71:7 contains both the purpose لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ and their act of covering themselves.
71:25 moves from their faults to comprehensive drowning before 71:26 names الْكَافِرِينَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three materially different coverings; I infer a reversal from refused protection through chosen obstruction to imposed engulfment. A live alternative is that the shared covering imagery is analogical and the drowning sequence is causally independent of the lexical branch.

changed_reading.before: Kāfirīn is a static designation for the people to be removed.
changed_reading.after: The focus closes a covering trajectory: those who refused protective covering and installed obstructive covering have been engulfed, and no carrier of that regime is to remain on earth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because دَيَّار normally activates the resident branch, while the ritual-circling branch belongs to the wider د و ر inventory. It remains anchored in the focus word and is activated by the immediately preceding command to preserve named idols. Downstream prose should present it only as a cultic-orbit overlay, never as the lexical translation of دَيَّارًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دَيَّارًا can weakly echo the ritual-circling branch of د و ر beside its primary resident sense.

activation_trace.role: The command not to abandon supplies the act that keeps a cultic orbit operating.
A named worshipped idol supplies the center around which preservation is organized.
A second idol confirms that the preceding system has multiple cultic centers.
A place or object circled in ritual supplies the exploratory orbit image inside the focus anchor.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, leave no human remainder capable of continuing the ritual orbit around the preserved cult objects.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and is therefore deliberately form-distant: قَالَ still means spoke. It remains inspectably anchored in the focus speech verb and gains force from the surah's repeated increase formulas. Downstream prose should describe it as a branch-triggered sound or performative echo of decrease, not as morphology or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَقَالَ is branch-mapped non-dominantly to the fewness image of ق ل ل.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply the repeated operation that Noah's focus speech counteracts.
A later increase formula confirms that additive change structures the surrounding discourse.
Fewness and smallness turn the utterance into an exploratory performative image of subtraction.
Negated leaving supplies the operation by which the remainder is reduced to none.

changed_reading.before: The speech frame merely reports that Noah spoke.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, Noah's saying performs a counter-increase, asking that the remaining population be reduced from fewness to zero.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material model linking promised rain and rivers to later engulfment, then reading fertile earth, seed-covering, and circulation in the focus as concern about what follows the reset. It remains anchored in الْأَرْضِ, الْكَافِرِينَ, and دَيَّارًا, but the packet does not explicitly state that blessing-water becomes flood-water. Downstream prose should mark that hydraulic reversal as reader inference rather than narrative identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Fertile الْأَرْضِ, seed-covering الْكَافِرِينَ, and circular دَيَّارًا receive a water-cycle activation.

activation_trace.role: Abundant outflow from a source supplies provisioned water entering the terrestrial system.
A river cutting earth with flowing water supplies the productive channel state.
Comprehensive engulfment supplies the same material in an annihilating saturation state.
Fertile earth supplies the substrate altered by either productive flow or saturation.
Covered seed supplies the latent post-water possibility of renewed growth.
Circulation supplies the possibility that the terrestrial system could begin another turn.

changed_reading.before: The flood removes the present inhabitants and the prayer asks for completeness.
changed_reading.after: After water reverses from provision to total saturation, the prayer asks that the reset earth contain no latent resident seed from which the same covering system can turn again.

strongest_changes: The exact leave-command used to preserve the idols is reversed against the resident humans who preserve them.
The prayer reads as terminal closure at a previously announced non-deferrable term, not simply as initiation of punishment.
Earthly growth, return, extraction, and later birth turn zero survivors into interruption of a terrestrial-social regeneration circuit.
The following prayer for believing kin and house entrants makes the requested absence a selective habitation boundary rather than undifferentiated depopulation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse became most active where its compact leave, earth, covering, and resident vocabulary was replayed as command reversal, temporal closure, household sorting, and material circulation. The same branch images support several coexisting mechanisms without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the circular and ritual ranges of د و ر should remain overlays on the primary resident sense or influence rendered prose at all.
Whether the earth-return sequence and the birth prediction are intended as one regeneration mechanism or only become coupled by reader inference.
Whether the placement of completed drowning before the focus speech establishes chronology or serves a rhetorical ordering.
Whether the protective, obstructive, and engulfing coverings form a deliberate sequence or only a productive branch-level analogy.
